weapon.d:
Enables Canto (Dist.; Max 3, Min 1).
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants【Time Dilation】,【Preempt Pulse】, and 【Null Follow-Up】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+15 to unit, unit deals +25 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials). If decreasing the Spd difference necessary to make a follow-up attack by 10 would allow unit to trigger a follow-up attack (excluding guaranteed or prevented follow-ups), triggers 【Potent Follow 100%】during combat.
【Time Dilation】
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit and unit deals +10 damage during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and if unit initiated combat, enables【Cadenza】against any foe within X spaces of unit after combat (excluding after【Cadenza】; X = unit's attack range +1; 【Cadenza】can only be enabled by this effect once per turn for the entire map).
【Preempt Pulse】
Grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit before unit's first attack during combat.
【Null Follow-Up】
If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.
【Potent Follow 100%】
Triggers an additional follow-up attack immediately after unit's standard follow-up attack and deals damage = 100% of unit's normal attack damage (if unit cannot make a follow-up attack, this effect triggers when the standard follow-up attack would occur; this effect is treated like a follow-up attack, so effects like "reduce damage by X%" still apply, but this effect is not affected by effects that prevent follow-ups or "attacks twice" effects; only highest value applied; does not stack).
【Cadenza】
After combat initiated by unit (after post-combat skills are triggered; before post-action skills and Canto are triggered; Penalty effects that last through unit's action are neutralized), unit can attack foe again once, within a specified distance, regardless of unit's Range.
Unit suffers a counterattack if any of the following conditions are met: foe can counterattack regardless of unit's Range, unit's Range = foe's Range, or foe's Range is the same as the distance between unit and foe. Skill effect's Range is determined by unit's weapon's Range. Unit's space before movement and unit's remaining movement referenced by the skill remain the same as before Cadenza. Unit cannot move, use Style, or attack structures; unit's area-of-effect Specials cannot be triggered, and after-combat movement effects do not occur. If unit uses Cadenza on foe that is within range of another Cadenza effect, Cadenza is treated as if having been triggered, including the other effect. Only highest value applied; does not stack. Does not trigger when affected by effects of Foresight Snare or traps in Aether Raids. Cadenza can be used only once per turn for player team in Summoner Duels. Does not trigger in Pawns of Loki.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of damage dealt to unit.
Boosts damage by 50% of damage dealt to unit.

When Special triggers, boosts damage by unit's Spd.
At start of turn, and after unit acts (if Canto triggers, after Canto), inflicts Spd/Res-7, 【Sabotage】, and【Discord】on closest foes and any foe within 2 spaces of those foes through their next actions.
Reduces damage from foe's attacks by X% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials; if unit initiates combat, X = number of allies on the map with the Time Dilation effect active, including unit, × 5, + 40; max 60; otherwise, X = 40.)
Up to twice per turn, the following effect (A) can be triggered: After Canto (including cases where action is ended due to Canto Control), grants another action to unit, and re-enables Canto (does not trigger when affected by effects of traps in Aether Raids during Canto).
If effect A has remaining activations, then unit can use the following【Style】:
――――――― Light Eternal Style ―――――――
Deals damage = 20% of unit's Spd, reduces damage from foe's first attack to a maximum of 1 ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes), and disables skills of all foes excluding foe in combat during combat.
After an action where this Style is used, remaining activations of effect A are reduced by 1.
―――――――――――――――――――――――――
【Sabotage】
Inflicts penalty on unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = highest penalty on each stat between unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit. Calculates each stat penalty independently.
【Discord】
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-X on unit during combat (X = 2 + number of allies within 2 spaces of unit; max 5).
【Style】
Change Style using the Style button at the bottom of the screen.
A unit's Style is only active when that unit is taking an action. Style use is disabled when unit is deployed using Pair Up or when unit is equipped with multiple skills that have a Style.

a.d: If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+3 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+5 during combat.

If unit initiates combat or is within 3 spaces of an ally, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd = unit's maximum Special cooldown count value + 8, unit deals damage = unit's maximum Special cooldown count value × X (excluding area-of-effect Specials; when Special triggers, X = 5; otherwise, X = 3), reduces damage from foe's first attack by 7 ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes), and neutralizes effects that inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit during combat.

b.d: If unit initiates combat or foe's Range = 2, and if unit's or foe's attack can trigger unit's Special, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = unit's max Special cooldown count value - 1, × 4 (max 16%).

If unit initiates combat or foe's Range = 2, and if unit's or foe's attack can trigger unit's Special, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = unit's max Special cooldown count value - 1, × 7 (max 28%).

If unit initiates combat or foe's Range = 2, and if unit's or foe's attack can trigger unit's Special, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = unit's max Special cooldown count value - 1, × 10 (max 40%).

At start of turn, and after unit acts (if Canto triggers, after Canto), inflicts【Res Shackle】 on closest foes and foes within 2 spaces of those foes through their next actions.
Inflicts Spd/Res-4 on foe, unit deals damage = unit's max Special cooldown count value × 5 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by unit's max Special cooldown count value × 3 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit before unit's first attack during combat.
【Res Shackle】
Inflicts penalty on unit's Res during combat = number of Penalty effects active on unit + 4, excluding stat penalties (max 8).

For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 during combat and restores 7 HP after combat.
Unit deals +5 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials) and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 5 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).
